items.title: 第 1 题 · 鼠标器是输入设备

items.layout: A＝仓库进货口与出货口｜B＝输入输出箭头示意｜C＝三种说法划叉｜D＝结论条
items.prompt: Flat illustration, landscape, four-zone layout, pale grey-blue background, blue and teal palette with green used only for the correct item, rounded lines, generous white space. Zone A (left, about 60% width): a small warehouse facade with two gates side by side; the left gate is marked as an intake and a queue of items walks in — a keyboard, a mouse, a flatbed scanner and a stylus pen — while the right gate is marked as an outbound gate and a printer, a monitor and a plotter walk away from it; a worker with a clipboard checks the intake queue; the mouse stands first in the intake line and is highlighted with a soft glow; boxes, a trolley and a small parcel stack fill the yard. Zone B (upper right): a plain computer body block with a wide arrow pointing inward from the left labelled as data going in, and a narrower arrow pointing outward on the right labelled as results coming out; small icon chips sit on each arrow. Zone C (lower right): a pale card with three small device plaques in a row, each crossed out by a thin grey line. Zone D (bottom full-width bar): a soft blue rounded conclusion strip with a green check badge. Text on the image is Simplified Chinese only, in four short labels: "输入设备", "进货口", "出货口", "鼠标器" — bold sans-serif on white rounded plates, each label no more than four characters. 16:9 landscape, high resolution, clean background.
